quotes.text: I represent the Northern Mariana Islands and one of our biggest challenges often, just our remote geography and our very limited access to technical expertise. So if Congress could do one thing to ensure that AI doesn't widen the gap for remote, isolated communities like mine, what would that look like? What would that investment be?

Artificial intelligence is transforming the way businesses operate, create jobs, and compete. 

During the House Small Business Committee hearing, I questioned witnesses on how Congress can better prepare our workforce and ensure small businesses in the Northern Mariana Islands have the tools they need to embrace emerging technologies.

Innovation should create opportunities for every community, including ours. Our office remains committed to advancing policies that help CNMI small businesses adapt, grow, and compete while preparing our workforce for the jobs of tomorrow. 

Together, we can ensure the Marianas are ready for the future.

Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing how businesses compete, innovate, and grow. 

During the House Small Business Committee hearing, AI on Main Street: How AI is Shaping the Future of Small Business, I questioned witnesses on how Congress can help ensure small businesses and workers in the Northern Mariana Islands are prepared for this evolving landscape.

Our office remains committed to advancing policies that expand opportunities for CNMI entrepreneurs, strengthen our workforce, and ensure our islands are not left behind as new technologies shape the future of the American economy.

We recently met with representatives from ControlAI, a nonprofit organization focused on the safe development and governance of artificial intelligence, to discuss the rapid advancement of AI and the emergence of artificial superintelligence (ASI). Our conversation focused on the growing national security implications of ASI and the important role Congress will play in shaping policies that encourage innovation while ensuring these technologies are developed responsibly. [...] AI is increasingly becoming a strategic issue in the competition between the United States and China, and it is essential that America remains the global leader in this critical technology while putting appropriate safeguards in place.
